name: A broadcast-venue design builds a furnished radio station whose writing stays bound through study navigation and a checkpoint

design.title: Static on the Night Shift
design.premise: A volunteer community radio station keeps its overnight request show running as the outbreak reaches the transmitter block.
design.opening: The last caller asked for a song nobody could find. Keep the signal up until the helicopter comes.

rooms.title: Station Lobby
